inference.title: A100 · atom DiT block (AF3 Alg. 23, dense attention over all N atoms) · inference · d 128, cond 128, pair 16, 4 heads × 32, transition n = 2, bf16

panels.label: one block, A samples with a conditioning per atom; the pair bias is made on every call (the pair tensor is read once per block)

kernels.name: AdaLN
code: ĉ = LN(cond) · γ                          # weight only
xa = LN(x) · sigmoid(ĉ Wsᵀ + bs) + ĉ Wshᵀ

kernels.name: q | k | v | g projection
kernels.impl: cuBLAS · 1 GEMM (the four weights packed once per version)
code: [q | k | v | g] = xa [Wq; Wk; Wv; Wg]ᵀ + [bq, 0, 0, 0]

kernels.name: pair bias
code: bias[h] = rstd (z · W'[h] − mean Σ_{c} W'[h, c])    # W' = γ Wb
masked and padded keys = −1e4, padded query rows 0

kernels.name: attention with the gate
code: s = q kᵀ / √32 + bias          # base 2, per sample and head
og = sigmoid(g) · softmax(s) v          # the gate in the epilogue

kernels.name: output projection, conditioning gate, residual
code: y = og @ Woᵀ;   g2 = cond @ Wscᵀ + bsc
x1 = x + sigmoid(g2) · y                # one row pass

kernels.name: AdaLN of the transition
code: xt = LN(x1) · sigmoid(ĉ Ws'ᵀ + bs') + ĉ Wsh'ᵀ

kernels.name: conditioned transition + residual
code: h = silu(xt Waᵀ) · (xt Wbᵀ)     # hidden 256
out = x1 + sigmoid(cond Wsc'ᵀ + b) · (h Wsᵀ)

hbm.name: single, cond, out, xa, y, g2, x1, xt

training.title: A100 · atom DiT block (AF3 Alg. 23, dense attention over all N atoms) · training · d 128, cond 128, pair 16, 4 heads × 32, transition n = 2, bf16

panels.label: forward (saves the AdaLN statistics and gates, qkvg, o, lse, the bias, y, g2, the transition's activations)

kernels.name: AdaLN
code: ĉ = LN(cond) · γ;   [s | b] = ĉ [Ws | Wsh]ᵀ + [bs | 0]
xa = sigmoid(s) · LN(x) + b             # statistics, gate saved

kernels.name: q | k | v | g projection
kernels.impl: cuBLAS · 1 GEMM (the four weights packed once per version)
code: [q | k | v | g] = xa [Wq; Wk; Wv; Wg]ᵀ + [bq, 0, 0, 0]

kernels.name: pair bias
code: bias[h] = LN(z) Wb[h]ᵀ, head-major [4,N,N]
masked and padded keys = −1e4

kernels.name: attention forward
code: s = q kᵀ / √32 + bias;   o = softmax(s) v
lse = log₂ Σ exp₂(s)                    # per sample, head, query

kernels.name: gate, output projection, residual
code: og = sigmoid(g) · o;   y = og @ Woᵀ;   g2 = cond @ Wscᵀ + bsc
x1 = x + sigmoid(g2) · y                # one row pass

kernels.name: transition
code: xt = AdaLN(x1, cond)                    # as F1
ab = xt [Wa | Wb]ᵀ;  h = silu(a) · b;  z = h Wsᵀ
out = x1 + sigmoid(cond Wsc'ᵀ + b) · z

hbm.name: single, cond, out, xa, xt, o, og, y, g2, x1, z

panels.label: backward; the attention kernels read the saved bias, lse and the row term D = Σ dO · O; the bias gradient leaves as bf16 partials of 4 samples

kernels.name: transition backward
code: dz = sigmoid(·) gate backward;  dh = dz Ws;  dWs = dzᵀ h
dab = swiglu'(ab) · dh;  dxt = dab [Wa | Wb];  dWab = dabᵀ xt

kernels.name: AdaLN backward (transition)
code: dscale = dxt · x̂ · gate (1 − gate);   dĉ = [dscale | dxt] [Ws; Wsh]
dx1 = LN-bwd(dxt · gate);   dcond, dγ = LN-bwd(dĉ)

kernels.name: residual gate, output projection, attention gate
code: dy = dx1 · sigmoid(g2);   dg2 = dx1 · y · sigmoid'(g2)
dog = dy @ Wo;  dWo = dyᵀ og
do = sigmoid(g) · dog;  dg = dog · o · sigmoid'(g)

kernels.name: attention backward, query side
code: D = Σ_d do · o;   P = exp₂(s − lse);   dP = do vᵀ
dS = P (dP − D);   dq = dS k;   dbias partials = Σ_{4 samples} dS
db = Σ partials                         # fixed order, bf16 → fp32

kernels.name: attention backward, key side
code: bias is read transposed [4,N(key),N(query)]
dv = Pᵀ do;   dk = dSᵀ q

kernels.name: pair bias backward
code: dxh = Σ_h db[h] W'[h];   dz = rstd (dxh − mean dxh − x̂ mean(dxh x̂))
dW'[h, c] = Σ_ij db[h] x̂[c]            # per-block partials, fixed order

kernels.name: projections, conditioning gate, AdaLN backward
kernels.impl: cuBLAS · 4 GEMMs, Triton AdaLN backward as B2
code: dxa = [dq | dk | dv | dg] Wqkvg;   dWqkvg = [dq | dk | dv | dg]ᵀ xa
dcond += dg2 Wsc;   dWsc = dg2ᵀ cond
dsingle = dx1 + AdaLN-bwd(dxa);   dcond (all the contributions)

hbm.name: do, dy, dg2, dx1, dxt, dsingle, dcond
dqkvg (dq | dk | dv written in place, dg beside them)
